features.text: PDAC Approved L4361/L4360 for Walker Boot with Customizable Fit
Full bootie enclosure provides complete foot coverage for enhanced protection and support for the entire foot. This feature is essential for individuals seeking comprehensive foot care and comfort.
Strong and durable aluminum shell with a foam innersole cushions the foot and provides stability.
Unique design prevents self-inflation, ensuring consistent support and comfort.
Customizable liner can be trimmed to fit the patient's needs, providing a customizable and snug fit that enhances overall comfort.

measurement: For the best fit, please consult the provided sizing chart or contact us at for our perfect fit promise.
